name: Dino Game v2
idea: Run, jump, and duck through a sprite-driven endless course with scrolling ground, cactus obstacles, and unlockable pterodactyls.
explanation: The publishable two-file version of the cf::gfx DinoGame migration. Its four sprite headers are generated from project assets and folded above DinoGame.h at build time.
deepExplanation: This source stays aligned with lib/DinoGame/DinoGame.{h,cpp}. The only source-level difference is that generated asset includes are absent from the publishable header because the website compiles dino, cactus, pterodactyl, and ground .cfsprite assets and prepends their generated declarations.
